arguments.summary: Implemented revised REQ-UI-002 with one shared internal template that clamps int and float dimensions to inclusive 1..4096. Existing viewport, direct layout, UI relayout, and event paths reuse the shared Geometry policy without changing public interfaces or synchronous one-event-per-request behavior. Updated the obsolete Geometry comment and five visible-test expectations. All 8 visible tests pass. Demonstrated STALE_INDEX rejection after editing, refreshed the index, and completed a verified-fresh final graph query.
